up: Retrieve all activity details for the parent compound CHEMBL2105717 (CABOZANTINIB) and all its related salts using the molecule_hierarchy table to identify the parent_molregno and all associated child molregnos. Include only rows where the assay target is CHEMBL3717 (Hepatocyte growth factor receptor) and the activity standard_type is 'IC50'. Return the following columns for all qualifying rows: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (prefer pubmed_id if available, else doi), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not limit the number of rows.
sql:
WITH hierarchy AS (
  SELECT parent.molregno AS molregno
  FROM molecule_dictionary parent
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2105717'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT child.molregno
  FROM molecule_hierarchy mh
  JOIN molecule_dictionary child ON child.molregno = mh.molregno
  JOIN molecule_dictionary parent ON parent.molregno = mh.parent_molregno
  WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL2105717'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.activity_comment,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  td.organism AS target_organism
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN hierarchy h ON a.molregno = h.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON h.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3717'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM';
